summary: Odysight.ai Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a firm-commitment underwritten offering of 3,437,500 common shares at $3.20 per share, raising gross proceeds of $11.0 million. Certain directors agreed to purchase 1,203,125 shares. The underwriter has a 30-day option for 515,625 additional shares. This is a routine equity capital raise, not a special situation. The company is a smaller reporting company and complies with S-3 General Instruction I.B.6 limits. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes. No special-situation dynamics such as control change, tender, or restructuring are present.
